strongest_simple_baseline: Already qualified original ZIP/hash/chunk/reassembly/upload verifier and just-in-time existing predownload disk guard. Reuse exact code; no framework or new retention format.
causal_contribution: Permanent copies of already terminal originals only. Sequential one original plus chunks per runner; two independent archive runners reduce retention wait. No source removal.
complete_costs: Both archive jobs plus all failures/source metadata/log availability/download/wholeSHA/CRC/chunk/upload/proof costs retained; API intervals not CPU/billed usage; human unknown. Current active sources and finite publication tail excluded for later closure.
integrity_boundary: Fresh independent GitHub connector completed-success run metadata, both published releases and fully paginated asset metadata including final empty pages. Exact asset fields also agree with embedded release assets. Existing two small public metadata bodies per release independently rehashed against remote digests. Every ledger/checksum, frozen76 scope, all88 originals and original-or-chunk/reassembly linkage, and88 predownload guards verified. Original ZIP CRC/SHA/reassembly bodies were checked by exact qualified Actions code; originals/chunks/log bodies/raw/journals/SQLite/models were not downloaded or rehashed locally. Original sources retained.
capacity_limit: All88 historical predownload guards passed; this is not current capacity or universal ENOSPC assurance.
